authority: CEO R325 §P3 — machine chooses next experiment via EIG

experiment_selection_engine.method: Expected Information Gain (EIG) per cost, per time, per risk
experiment_selection_engine.formula: EIG = H(prior) - E[H(posterior)] where H is Shannon entropy over hypothesis states
experiment_selection_engine.decision_rule: Choose experiment with highest EIG / (cost × time × risk)

current_portfolio_experiment_queue.info_gain: MEDIUM (47.3% prediction, may not survive hardware)

machine_recommendation.rationale: Highest EIG/cost ratio (1.7). Completely untested mechanism. Low risk. Moderate cost ($7.5K). 30-day timeline but high information gain. If PASS, P-20 moves to TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE (pre-clinical). If FAIL, P-20 goes to CEMETERY with reusable knowledge about PLGA-IL-10 kinetics.
machine_recommendation.second_choice: P-10 valve response time (EIG/cost 1.6, shorter timeline 4 weeks)
machine_recommendation.third_choice: P-07 safety floor (EIG/cost 1.2, shortest timeline 3 weeks)
machine_recommendation.selection_logic: The machine prioritizes: (1) untested mechanisms (higher info gain), (2) lower cost (more experiments per budget), (3) shorter timeline (faster feedback loop), (4) lower risk (less likely to produce ambiguous results). P-20 wins on all four criteria except timeline (7 weeks vs 3-4 for alternatives), but the information gain advantage outweighs the time cost.
